scripts.build:extensions: npm run build -w workpulse-core && npm run build -w workpulse-jira
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:api && npm run build:webview && npm run build:extensions
scripts.watch:all: concurrently --kill-others -n "core,jira,webview" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run watch -w workpulse-core" "npm run watch -w workpulse-jira" "npm run watch --prefix workpulse-webview"
